title: Python Variables & Data Types
content: Python supports dynamic typing. Common types: int, float, str, bool, list, tuple, dict, set. Variables are created on assignment: x = 5. Type conversion: int('5'), str(5). Strings are immutable, lists are mutable. Dictionaries store key-value pairs.
answers: what is a variable in python
how to declare variables in python

title: Python Functions & Scope
content: Define functions with def keyword. Default parameters, *args for variable positional args, **kwargs for keyword args. Lambda for anonymous functions. Variables defined inside functions are local scope. Use global keyword or return values to access outside.
snippet:
def greet(name='World'):
    return f'Hello, {name}!'

add = lambda a, b: a + b
print(greet())  # Hello, World!
print(add(2, 3))  # 5
answers: how to define a function in python

title: Python Loops & Iteration
content: for loops iterate over sequences. range(start, stop, step) generates numbers. while loops repeat while condition is true. Use break to exit, continue to skip, else clause runs when loop completes normally.
answers: how to break out of loop in python

title: Python OOP & Classes
content: Python OOP: classes created with class keyword. __init__ is constructor. self refers to instance. Inheritance via class Child(Parent). Method overriding, super() calls parent. Properties with @property decorator.

title: Python Error Handling
content: Try/except blocks handle exceptions. except catches specific exception types. finally runs always. else runs if no error. raise to throw manually. Common exceptions: ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, FileNotFoundError.

title: JavaScript Basics
content: JavaScript: let for mutable variables, const for constants, var is legacy. Primitive types: string, number, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, bigint. Objects are key-value pairs. Functions are first-class citizens.

title: JavaScript Promises & Async/Await
content: Promises represent async operations. States: pending, fulfilled, rejected. async/await is syntactic sugar. try/catch handles rejection. Promise.all for parallel. fetch() returns a promise. Event loop handles async.

title: JavaScript Array Methods
content: Modern JS array methods: map transforms, filter selects, reduce aggregates, forEach iterates, find locates first match, some/every test conditions, sort orders, includes checks existence.

title: React Hooks
content: React hooks: useState for state, useEffect for side effects, useContext for context, useRef for mutable refs, useMemo/useCallback for performance. Rules: call at top level, only in functional components.

title: SQL Basics
content: SQL: SELECT retrieves, INSERT adds, UPDATE modifies, DELETE removes. WHERE filters, JOIN combines tables, GROUP BY aggregates, ORDER BY sorts. LIMIT restricts rows. Primary keys uniquely identify rows.
snippet:
SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY u.name, o.total
ORDER BY o.total DESC
LIMIT 10;

title: SQL JOINs Explained
content: INNER JOIN returns matching rows in both tables. LEFT JOIN returns all left table rows + matches from right. RIGHT JOIN is opposite. FULL OUTER JOIN returns all rows from both. CROSS JOIN is Cartesian product.
answers: sql inner join vs left join

title: Node.js Basics
content: Node.js runs JS on server. CommonJS require() or ESM import. Key modules: http, fs, path, crypto. Express is popular web framework. npm manages packages. NODE_ENV controls environment.

title: Docker Basics
content: Docker containers package apps with dependencies. Dockerfile defines build. docker build creates image, docker run starts container. docker-compose runs multi-container apps. Images are read-only templates, containers are runnable instances.
snippet:
# Dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

title: Git Essentials
content: Git tracks changes. git init starts repo, git add stages, git commit saves snapshot, git push uploads, git pull downloads. Branches isolate work. Merge combines. Rebase rewrites history. Stash saves uncommitted work.
snippet:
git init
git add .
git commit -m 'Initial commit'
git branch feature
 git checkout feature
git push origin main
git pull
git stash

title: CSS Flexbox
content: Flexbox lays out items in one direction. display:flex on container. flex-direction row/column. justify-content aligns main axis, align-items cross axis. flex-grow/flex-shrink control sizing. gap for spacing.

title: Python Flask API
content: Flask creates web apps/APIs. @app.route decorators bind URLs to functions. Methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE. request.json parses body. jsonify returns JSON. Blueprints organize routes. Flask-CORS handles cross-origin.

title: TypeScript Basics
content: TypeScript adds static types to JS. interface defines object shapes. type aliases. Generics with <T>. Union types A|B. Optional ?. Non-null !. Enums. Compiles to JS with tsc.

title: HTTP Status Codes & Curl
content: HTTP status: 2xx success, 3xx redirect, 4xx client error, 5xx server error. Common: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 429 Too Many, 500 Server Error.
snippet:
# GET
e curl -X GET https://api.example.com/items
# POST
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/items \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name": "Item"}'
# Auth
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' URL

title: Python Hello World + File I/O
content: File I/O with open() and context manager 'with'. Read: mode='r', write: 'w', append: 'a', binary: 'b'. Paths via os/pathlib. Always close files or use with block for auto cleanup.
snippet:
with open('data.txt', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

with open('output.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('Hello\n')

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('data.txt')
if p.exists():
    print(p.read_text())
